summary: Replaced the static frontend with a Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui teacher console that generates, previews, audits, checks, prints, and copies canonical worksheet JSON.

commands_run.notes: Passed with warnings for older manual result-state mismatches and older ready-task path overlaps.
Validated 3 valid fixtures and 1 invalid fixture.
Checked 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items.
Next webpack build passed; route / prerendered as static content.

acceptance_results.criterion: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn configuration, and npm scripts are present
acceptance_results.notes: src/app, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, postcss.config.mjs, components.json, package scripts, static preview script, and shadcn UI source files are present.

acceptance_results.criterion: The root experience is a dense light teacher console with search, exact grade, strand, format filters, generator selection, settings, live preview, answer audit, answer checking, and print-safe output
acceptance_results.notes: src/features/worksheet/TeacherConsole.tsx renders the routed root console with those controls and print-safe worksheet preview.

acceptance_results.criterion: Worksheet generation returns canonical Worksheet JSON and uses it as the source for preview, answer key, checking, and print rendering
acceptance_results.notes: generateWorksheet returns Worksheet JSON consumed by preview, answerForQuestion, checkAnswer, auditWorksheet, JSON copy, and print.

acceptance_results.criterion: Typed helpers exist for filtering worksheet types, generating worksheets, auditing worksheets, and checking answers
acceptance_results.notes: src/features/worksheet exports typed filtering, generation, audit, answer lookup, and answer checking helpers.

acceptance_results.criterion: Generator verification covers every worksheet type and passes
acceptance_results.notes: npm run test:generators and node scripts/verify-generators.js checked 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items.

acceptance_results.criterion: Static index.html, app.js, and styles.css are retired so there is not a second frontend system
acceptance_results.notes: Tracked static frontend files are deleted and the routed Next page imports TeacherConsole.

acceptance_results.criterion: Vercel and README documentation reflect the Next.js deployment path
acceptance_results.notes: README and docs/testing describe the Next.js deployment and verification path; vercel.json keeps deployment headers and sets outputDirectory to out.

risks: Browser automation was not available in this container; static HTTP and exported HTML shell checks passed instead.
Only one frontend/core workflow test exists so far; future work should add UI interaction and print layout coverage.
